actName: Constitution of India - Article 21A (Right to Education)
purpose: Requires the State to provide free and compulsory education to children aged six to fourteen years in the manner determined by law.

actName: Constitution of India - Article 29 (Protection of Interests of Minorities)
purpose: Protects the right of groups with a distinct language, script, or culture to conserve it, and prohibits specified forms of denial of admission to State-maintained or aided institutions.

actName: Constitution of India - Article 30 (Minority Educational Institutions)
purpose: Protects the right of religious and linguistic minorities to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice, subject to the Constitution.

actName: Constitution of India - Article 45 (Early Childhood Care and Education)
purpose: Directs the State to endeavour to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete six years of age.

actName: Constitution of India - Article 46 (Promotion of Educational and Economic Interests)
purpose: Directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of weaker sections, particularly Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and protect them from social injustice and exploitation.

actName: Constitution of India - Article 51A(k) (Fundamental Duty of Parent or Guardian)
purpose: Makes it a fundamental duty of a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to a child or ward between six and fourteen years of age.

actName: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
purpose: Provides the statutory framework for free and compulsory elementary education for children aged six to fourteen years and sets duties for governments, local authorities, and schools.

actName: University Grants Commission Act, 1956
purpose: Provides for coordination and determination of standards in university education and establishes the University Grants Commission.

actName: All India Council for Technical Education Act, 1987
purpose: Establishes the All India Council for Technical Education and provides for coordinated development and standards in technical education.

actName: National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993
purpose: Provides for the planned and coordinated development of teacher education and the maintenance of norms and standards for teacher-education programmes.

actName: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
purpose: Recognizes rights of persons with disabilities, including equality and non-discrimination, and provides for inclusive education and accessibility obligations.

actName: National Medical Commission Act, 2019
purpose: Establishes the National Medical Commission and provides a framework for medical education, professional standards, and regulation of medical institutions.

actName: Advocates Act, 1961
purpose: Consolidates the law relating to legal practitioners and provides for the constitution of the Bar Council of India and State Bar Councils.

actName: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
purpose: Protects children from sexual offences and establishes procedures for reporting, investigation, and trial, including child-sensitive safeguards.

actName: Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986
purpose: Prohibits the employment of children in specified work and regulates the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations and processes.

actName: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
purpose: Provides a framework for children in conflict with law and children in need of care and protection, including child-protection mechanisms relevant to education settings.

actName: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005
purpose: Establishes the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights and related commissions to review safeguards and address violations of children's rights.

actName: Central Educational Institutions (Reservation in Admission) Act, 2006
purpose: Provides for reservation in admission of students belonging to specified socially and educationally backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes in covered central educational institutions.

actName: National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992
purpose: Establishes the National Commission for Minorities to monitor safeguards and consider matters relating to the development of notified minority communities.

actName: Institutes of Technology Act, 1961
purpose: Declares specified institutions to be institutions of national importance and provides for their incorporation and governance as Indian Institutes of Technology.

actName: National Institutes of Technology, Science Education and Research Act, 2007
purpose: Declares specified National Institutes of Technology and the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, to be institutions of national importance and provides for their governance.

actName: Indian Institute of Management Act, 2017
purpose: Declares specified Indian Institutes of Management to be institutions of national importance and provides for their governance and degree-awarding powers.

actName: Indian Institutes of Information Technology (Public-private Partnership) Act, 2017
purpose: Provides for declaration and governance of specified Indian Institutes of Information Technology established through public-private partnerships as institutions of national importance.

actName: All-India Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 1956
purpose: Provides for the establishment of the All-India Institute of Medical Sciences and its governance as an institution of national importance.

actName: National Institutes of Design Act, 2014
purpose: Declares specified National Institutes of Design to be institutions of national importance and provides for their governance and educational functions.

actName: Banaras Hindu University Act, 1915
purpose: Incorporates Banaras Hindu University and provides for its objectives, powers, and governance.

actName: Aligarh Muslim University Act, 1920
purpose: Incorporates Aligarh Muslim University and provides for its objectives, powers, and governance.

actName: University of Delhi Act, 1922
purpose: Incorporates the University of Delhi and provides for its powers, authorities, and governance.

actName: Jawaharlal Nehru University Act, 1966
purpose: Establishes Jawaharlal Nehru University and provides for its academic objectives, powers, and governance.

actName: Indira Gandhi National Open University Act, 1985
purpose: Establishes the Indira Gandhi National Open University to promote and coordinate open and distance learning and related educational activities.

actName: Jamia Millia Islamia Act, 1988
purpose: Provides for the incorporation and governance of Jamia Millia Islamia as a central university.

actName: Central Universities Act, 2009
purpose: Establishes and incorporates specified central universities and provides a common framework for their governance and related matters.

actName: Delhi School Education Act, 1973
purpose: Provides for the regulation of school education in the National Capital Territory of Delhi, including recognition and administration of schools.

actName: Karnataka Education Act, 1983
purpose: Consolidates and amends the law relating to educational institutions and the development of education in Karnataka.

actName: Maharashtra Educational Institutions (Regulation of Fee) Act, 2011
purpose: Provides for regulation of fees in specified educational institutions in Maharashtra and establishes related review mechanisms.

actName: Maharashtra Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1999
purpose: Prohibits ragging in educational institutions in Maharashtra and provides for penalties and related measures.

actName: Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1997
purpose: Prohibits ragging in educational institutions in Tamil Nadu and provides for punishment of offences.

actName: Kerala Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1998
purpose: Prohibits ragging in educational institutions in Kerala and provides for penalties and institutional responsibilities.

actName: Uttar Pradesh Self-Financed Independent Schools (Fee Regulation) Act, 2018
purpose: Provides for regulation of fees charged by covered self-financed independent schools in Uttar Pradesh.

actName: Rajasthan Non-Government Educational Institutions Act, 1989
purpose: Provides for recognition, regulation, and related matters concerning non-government educational institutions in Rajasthan.

actName: West Bengal Primary Education Act, 1973
purpose: Provides for the development, management, and administration of primary education in West Bengal.

actName: Karnataka State Universities Act, 2000
purpose: Provides a statutory framework for the establishment, incorporation, and governance of specified state universities in Karnataka.

actName: Maharashtra Public Universities Act, 2016
purpose: Provides a framework for the establishment and administration of public universities in Maharashtra.

actName: Tamil Nadu Universities Act, 1923
purpose: Provides for the establishment and governance of the University of Madras and related matters in Tamil Nadu.
